CLXXHI. im Dorfe Priethal um �?4 Schock weniger sieben Groschen. In nomine domini amen. Cum olim inter honorabiles et religio sos viros abbatem ac conuentum monasterii in Altouado Pragensis diocesis ex vna et discretum virum dominum Przibiconem plebanum ecclesie parrochialis in Prziedol super decimarum jure et recepcione earundem gwerre et querele et diuersarum materiarum questiones parte verterentur ab altera, nos Johannes de Rosennbergh cupientes prefatorum monasterii et ecclesie parochialis querelis et earum iac- turis, que exinde emergi in futurum possent, et dampnum non mo dicum monasterio et ecclesie in preiudicium predictorum fideliter obuiare, tenore presencium vniuersis presentibus et futuris volumus publice declarare, quod maturo prehabito et precedente consilio prefatis abbati et conuentui in Altouado deuotis nostris singulariter dilectis in pre fata willa Prziedol super decem et octo laneis, super quolibet prefata laneo viginti et septem denarios Wienenses, vero titulo vendicionis asignamus et jure hereditario vendentes perpetuo resignamus ab ipsis fratribus de Altowado pro prefatis censibus quatuordecim sexagenas grossorum minus septem grossis in parata pecunia recipiendo , tali condicione notabiliter anotata, quod incolis et censualibus ipsius wille Prziedol de quolibet prescriptorum decem et octo laneorum singulis annis de summa census quam nobis nostris 206 et predecessoribus ab antiquo dare et porrigere solebant, prefati viginti septem Vienenses annuatim debeant deperire, ita quod ¡psi incole ob gratiam eis buiusmodi factam plebano dicte ecclesie in Priedol, qui est vel erit in futurum, de quolibet premissorum decem et octo laneorum vnam thinam siliginis et vnam thinam auene in grano triturato et mensurato et prefatis fratribus in Altouado omnium annonarum, videlicet siliginis tritici ordei et ¡тоne, pro decimis veris decimum capete in campis dent deciment et assignent sine omni obmissione annis perpetuis cum effectu. Promittimus vna cum nobilibus dominis Vlrico fratre et Henrico fratueli nostris dominis de Rosennbergh prefatam vendicionem census prescripti bona et sincera fide ratam et fir m ¡im perpetuo iuuiolabiliter obseruare testi monio et robore barum litterarum, quibus sigilla nostra de certa nostra sciencia sunt appensa. Sub anno domini millésimei trecente- simo octuagesimo octano dominica „Letare" in quadragesima qua cantatur. Die anhängenden Siegel der drei Rosenberger sind bereits beschrieben.
entries.english:
1388, 8 March. To prevent further disputes between the parish priest of Priethal and Hohenfurt Monastery over the Priethal tithe, Johann von Rosenberg sells the monastery the rents from seven hides in Priethal for 14 score less seven groschen.

CLXXIII. In the name of the Lord, amen. Since disputes, quarrels, and various controversies have arisen between the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt Monastery in the diocese of Prague on one side and the discreet Lord Przibiko, parish priest of Priethal, on the other concerning the right to tithes and their collection, we, Johann von Rosenberg, wishing faithfully to prevent the monastery and parish church from suffering further quarrels, losses, or considerable harm as a result, publicly declare to all present and future that, after mature counsel, we assign to the abbot and convent of Hohenfurt, our especially dear and devoted friends, by sale and hereditary right, the rents on eighteen hides in the aforesaid village of Priethal, at twenty-seven Viennese denarii per hide, receiving from the brothers in ready money fourteen score of groschen less seven groschen. It is expressly stipulated that each year twenty-seven Viennese denarii shall be deducted from the customary rent paid to us and our predecessors by the inhabitants and rent-payers of each of the eighteen hides. In return for this concession, the inhabitants shall each year give and assign to the parish priest of Priethal, present or future, from each of the eighteen hides one bushel of rye and one bushel of oats, threshed and measured as grain. They shall also pay to the brothers at Hohenfurt a true tithe of all grain—rye, wheat, barley, and oats—namely one tenth part in the fields, without omission, every year forever.

Together with our noble lords Ulrich, our brother, and Henricus, our cousin, we promise in good and sincere faith to keep this sale of the aforesaid rent firm and inviolable forever. In testimony and confirmation, our seals are attached with our certain knowledge. In the year of the Lord 1388, on the Sunday Laetare in Lent.

The attached seals of the three Rosenbergs have already been described.
